items.name: CHORUS_SPREAD_RANGE
items.doc: The chorus's right-leg phase offset, in TURNS of its one oscillator (§2, §3a; the native-FX catalogue's M32 Dimension row). The right leg's voice k reads the LFO at k/N + spread: 0 is both legs one phase (the stage without the field, bit for bit), 0.25 quadrature, 0.5 the Dimension's opposed sweep. A fraction of a cycle carries no engineering symbol, so the unit is ''.

items.name: CHORUS_RATE_RANGE
items.doc: The chorus sweep's speed (§3a). Above ~3 Hz it stops being a chorus and becomes a vibrato.

items.name: CHORUS_DEPTH_RANGE
items.doc: The chorus's peak-to-peak excursion above its declared 10 ms base (§3a).

items.name: CHORUS_VOICES_RANGE
items.doc: The chorus's tap count — one oscillator read at k/N (§3a).

items.name: CHORUS_MIX_RANGE
items.doc: The chorus's wet/dry, as an instance of DRIVE_MIX_RANGE — the same percent travel, its own come-up value: 35 %, a colour under the dry on a strip (§3a). The REVERB_LOWCUT_RANGE-over- REVERB_CUT_RANGE shape: one travel, one declared default per field that reads it.
